function.arguments: {"reflection":"The initial broad search produced strong primary/vendor and government evidence. Key findings: Mandiant (SRC-003) explicitly identifies the initial intrusion into 3CX as malicious X_TRADER software downloaded from Trading Technologies, then reconstructs lateral movement and compromise of Windows/macOS build environments; it also gives the 3CX payload chain and UNC4736 assessment. Kaspersky (SRC-004) provides direct behavioral/technical observations, including MSI/macOS trojanization, DLL sideloading, C2/icon extraction, infostealer and Gopuram targeting. CSA Singapore (SRC-009) supplies affected versions and date. CrowdStrike summary in SRC-001 provides early observations, dates, platforms, signing, and Labyrinth Chollima assessment. Google TAG (SRC-005), MITRE (SRC-006/007), and WIRED (SRC-008) help compare attribution and prior AppleJeus/Trading Technologies evidence. Missing: exact chronology of earliest access versus X_TRADER compromise, more detailed build/signing/release mechanics, and competing initial-access narratives (e.g., phishing/social engineering versus supply-chain). Search narrower for primary reports on 3CX timeline, build/release, and initial access alternatives."}
function.name: think_tool
